errors.quote: The chirp phase at address $j$ is computed modulo $2r$ as $-\sum_is_ij_i^2(r/t_i)$
errors.problem: This integer is the phase numerator, not the phase. The paper computes the numerator N modulo 2r, with a_j = exp(2 pi i N/(2r)) = exp(-pi i sum_i s_i j_i^2/t_i); the phase angle is pi N/r.
